title: Instantaneous regularisation via Harnack-type methods for a degenerate non-local equation
summary: We prove an instantaneous smoothing effect for a degenerate non-local evolution equation (originally derived as the many-particle limit of a system of active Brownian particles). The underlying mechanism is that, by deriving a Harnack-type inequality for an averaged quantity, we are able to show that the equation becomes strongly parabolic for positive times, and thus self-regularising. This paper is a significant improvement of a previous work, where additional (weak) non-degeneracy assumptions were imposed on the initial data.
